description.value: Seiffert Market + Bakeshop is a student-run market and bakery operated by Vancouver Community College's award-winning baking and pastry arts program. It offers daily fresh baked goods, artisanal breads, imaginative cakes, prepared foods, and local coffee at its downtown Vancouver location near Dunsmuir and Hamilton. A touring cyclist looking for a quality pastry or coffee stop in central Vancouver will find this a memorable and affordable detour.
